import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,base64,hashlib
p=Path.cwd(); b=p.parent/'expanded-corpus-r378'; raw=base64.b64decode((b/'sources/prograph-journal.b64').read_text());print('journal',len(raw),hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
for num in [5,14,20,21]:
 r=subprocess.run(['pdftoppm','-f',str(num),'-singlefile','-scale-to','1200','-png','-'],input=raw,capture_output=True,timeout=20); assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr
 z=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/python3','-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),f'figures/journal-{num}.png','--base64'],input=base64.b64encode(r.stdout).decode(),text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=10); assert z.returncode==0,z.stderr
 print(num,len(r.stdout),hashlib.sha256(r.stdout).hexdigest())
print('SECTION4',(b/'sources/prograph-journal.txt').read_text().split('\f')[13][:2000])
print('ABS','\n'.join(l for l in (b/'sources/prograph-abs.html').read_text().splitlines() if any(x in l for x in ['v1','v2','journal_ref'])))
